note: *fiquei em silêncio quanto às coisas boas*, the gate's own fix after *longe do bem*. It runs eight syllables over the Latin colon (HANDOFF 18); *longe do bem* is the option.
*passa como uma imagem*, held against two Latinist minors asking *em imagem*, which is not a Portuguese sentence (D39). His wording is option 2.
*fizestes de mim a afronta do insensato*: two Latinist minors want the dative kept, but *afronta ao insensato* is heard as an insult to the fool. The verb-kept wording is option 3.
*Perdoai-me*, held against two Latinist minors (*Relevai-me*, then *Dai-me trégua*): *remítte mihi* is open between forgive and respite. Both are options.
